candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old and has had fever for 2 days. The temperature is 38.0°C. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. There is no obvious cause of fever seen and no identified bacterial cause at this time. Malaria risk is high in this area, malaria test is available and the result is negative. The child has not had measles within the last 3 months. There is generalized rash present. The child does not have mouth ulcers and does not have a cough with measles. There is pus draining from the eye and the eyes are red. There is no clouding of the cornea. The child does not have a stiff neck. The child does not have runny nose. The child does not have cough or difficult breathing, has not had diarrhoea, and does not have any ear problem. The child currently has fever.
